entry.title: Tractor Supply boosts same-day delivery options
entry.summary: The retailer is growing its delivery offerings at the same time Amazon is expanding its rural delivery network.

entry.title: Instagram creators can now add Amazon affiliate links directly to Reels, posts
entry.summary: Creators can add 30 products per Reel, or 20 per post, and earn commission — and Instagram won’t take a cut.

entry.title: Bath & Body Works CEO: ‘We are on track, but far from satisfied’
entry.summary: The retailer hit the one-year mark with its Consumer First Formula strategy and has a goal of returning the business to sustainable growth in 2027.

entry.title: The Backroom: How department stores are shaping up this holiday
entry.summary: The team looks at the past, present and future of a retail model that has long been a fixture of the season.

entry.title: Mall of America debuts AI-backed concierge, Mallie
entry.summary: The digital assistant is designed to help shoppers plan and personalize visits to North America’s largest shopping and entertainment complex.

entry.title: The Weekly Closeout: NYC bans surveillance pricing, FabFitFun lands in Walmart
entry.summary: The ban prevents companies from using personal data to tailor prices, while the subscription company is offering a beauty box in 3,000 of the mass merchant’s stores.

entry.title: Vuori exec to lead struggling Athleta
entry.summary: Ashley Kechter, who previously also had stints at Fabletics and Gap Inc., takes on a brand that just posted yet another quarter of double-digit declines.

entry.title: ThredUp leans into livestream shopping with TikTok Shop
entry.summary: After early success on Whatnot, the resale marketplace is expanding its livestream efforts with a launch on TikTok Shop.

entry.title: Warm weather thwarts Old Navy recovery, as Gap continues to shine
entry.summary: As the Gap Inc.’s value brand falters, its namesake has risen from a years-long slump to notch its 12th straight quarter of comparable sales growth.

entry.title: The Container Store is back online after cybersecurity incident
entry.summary: The incident has not impacted the security of customer financial data, according to the company.
